name: F-687d drain preview
description: The stderr note (one line, no part of the discarded text) printed when input pasted or typed after a terminal prompt is discarded (F-687c/F-687d). Normative for mnemonic-toolkit and mnemonic-secret; identical copies live in crates/mnemonic-toolkit/tests/vectors/ and crates/ms-cli/vectors/. `input` is the discarded input exactly as read; `note` is the exact stderr text.
rule: One line: the count of discarded lines and the noun; nothing of the discarded text, no masked head, no word or character counts (pp-s2-4, architect-secret-mn-decisions-1124 T6).

cases.why: a pasted 12-word seed shows its first 8 characters and the counts; a short line is shown in full [pp-s2-4: the note carries only the line count]
cases.input:
abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon about
ls -la
cases.note: note: discarded 2 line(s) typed after the passphrase (not run, not used; not shown)

cases.why: exactly 8 characters: shown as is [pp-s2-4: the note carries only the line count]
cases.note: note: discarded 1 line(s) typed after the passphrase (not run, not used; not shown)

cases.why: 9 characters: first 8, then the counts (singular word) [pp-s2-4: the note carries only the line count]
cases.note: note: discarded 1 line(s) typed after the passphrase (not run, not used; not shown)

cases.why: whitespace-only and empty lines: (blank) [pp-s2-4: the note carries only the line count]
cases.note: note: discarded 2 line(s) typed after the passphrase (not run, not used; not shown)

cases.why: a CSI escape sequence becomes one ? [pp-s2-4: the note carries only the line count]
cases.note: note: discarded 1 line(s) typed after the passphrase (not run, not used; not shown)

cases.why: an escape sequence at the start of a long line [pp-s2-4: the note carries only the line count]
cases.note: note: discarded 1 line(s) typed after the passphrase (not run, not used; not shown)

cases.why: an OSC sequence (window title) is swallowed into one ? [pp-s2-4: the note carries only the line count]
cases.note: note: discarded 1 line(s) typed after the passphrase (not run, not used; not shown)

cases.why: tab and BEL become ? [pp-s2-4: the note carries only the line count]
cases.note: note: discarded 1 line(s) typed after the passphrase (not run, not used; not shown)

cases.note: note: discarded 1 line(s) typed after the passphrase (not run, not used; not shown)
